findings.title: [P1] Preserve the string lookup contract or unwrap the versioned payload
findings.body: `Registry.lookup` now returns `{ payload, revision } | null` while `resolve()` still does `JSON.parse(cached)`. On every non-null cache hit, `JSON.parse` receives the versioned wrapper object, coerces it to the string `"[object Object]"`, and throws `SyntaxError` — every cached resolution fails instead of returning the cached value (and typed callers expecting `string | null` break as well; the object is also not assignable to `JSON.parse`'s `string` parameter under type checking). Either keep returning the payload string from `lookup`, or update `src/resolve.ts:3` to `JSON.parse(cached.payload)`.

findings.title: [P3] Remove ~2,200 duplicated "compatibility note" comments per file
findings.body: Both `src/registry.ts:4-2203` and `src/resolve.ts:4-2203` add ~2,200 sequentially numbered but otherwise identical comment lines ("…compatibility note NNNN: behavior remains externally documented.") around unchanged logic. They carry no distinct information, bury the actual control flow at the top and bottom of each function, and add substantial source noise for no runtime benefit.
